intro: Between 2026-04-12 and 2026-09-25, ZCyberNews covered 49 data-breach articles. ShinyHunters, LockBit, and Cl0p featured among the top threat actors, while CVE-2026-35273 stood out among the top CVEs. Government, healthcare, education, retail, and technology ranked as the most affected sectors. North america, United states, Europe, Global, and France were the most affected regions. The severity mix comprised 40 high and 6 medium items. This archive collects that reporting in one place.
